classification.difficultyReason: The side is split into a rectangle and a trapezium. The 12 m slope length must be found by subtraction (20 − 8). Then multiply by the width and convert m³ to litres. These are routine linked procedures with a clear diagram.

content.prompt: The given diagram is a sketch of a new 20 m swimming pool to be built at a school.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of one side of the pool (shaded).

answer.worked:
The sloping section is $20-8=12\text{ m}$ long.
$$\begin{aligned}A_1&=2.4\times8\\A_1&=19.2\text{ m}^2\\A_2&=\frac{2.4+1.2}{2}\times12\\A_2&=21.6\text{ m}^2\\A&=19.2+21.6\\A&=40.8\text{ m}^2\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the volume of the pool in cubic metres.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the capacity of the pool in litres, if $1\text{ m}^3=1000\text{ L}$.
